note: Rustic state forest campground on the shore of Garey Lake (perch, pike, bluegill), once an apple orchard, near Empire, Benzie County; managed by Interlochen State Park. Open to equestrian use (the western spur of the 420-mile Shore-to-Shore Trail enters the campground) but a general drive-in campground, separate from the Garey Lake Trail Camp group horse camp next door. A 36-ft rig was reported (8/2018), though reviewers say most sites suit smaller rigs and tents. Lake Ann Pathway six miles northeast. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 13 sites (table: 12; count new), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, ramp, first-come only. Changed max stay 14 -> 15 nights (DNR: 15-day maximum). Season (open all year) already manual and matches. Phone 231-276-9511 matches (Interlochen SP). Note trimmed of field restatements and the 14-day limit.
flags: Criteria check (horse camp?): the DNR amenity table types this campground 'equestrian - individual' (its neighbour Garey Lake Trail Camp is 'equestrian - group'). The DNR page describes '13 rustic campsites open to equestrian use' with the Shore-to-Shore Trail entering the campground and 'no picket posts', and sets no horse-only rule, so it reads as a general campground that also takes riders. A human should confirm it is not a horse camp.
